description: Curated local knowledge documents for Medi-AI. These are educational help content ONLY and are explicitly NOT clinically validated.

documents.title: How to prepare for a doctor visit

sources.name: Helora internal guidance (draft, not clinically validated)

sections: Write down your main concern and when it started before the visit.
Note any medicines you currently take, their doses, and any allergies.
List questions you want to ask so you do not forget them during the consultation.
Bring relevant reports or prescriptions if you have them.
This is general planning guidance and is not medical advice.

documents.title: How to describe your symptoms clearly

sources.name: Helora internal guidance (draft, not clinically validated)

sections: Mention when the symptom started and whether it appeared suddenly.
Describe the severity (for example mild, moderate, severe) in your own words.
Note what makes it better or worse, such as food, rest or activity.
Mention any other changes you noticed at the same time.
Providing clear descriptions helps a clinician understand your situation; it does not replace a professional evaluation.

documents.title: Safe questions to discuss about medicine

sources.name: Helora internal guidance (draft, not clinically validated)

sections: Medi-AI provides general educational information about medicines and never acts as a prescription engine.
Always confirm the medicine name, dose, and how to take it with a clinician or pharmacist.
Do not start, stop, or change any prescribed medicine without involving your clinician.
Ask your pharmacist about timing, food interactions, and possible side effects specific to your situation.
If you think you have taken too much medicine, seek help immediately - do not wait for an online response.
